title: Rename Travel Tools shop tile and add one-time random baseline for blog view counts

requirements.text: Update the Travel Tools tile currently titled “Print on Demand Travel Products” to display the title exactly as “TravelButts shop”, and make that tile navigate directly to the existing Shop page/route (use the same destination as the app’s current Shop navigation, not the coming-soon page).

quotes: Kunnen we de print on demand travel products, TravelButts shop noemen inplaats van print on demand travel products.

De tile staat bij de traveltools, en ik wil alleen de naam wijzigen ja. en alleen op de tile want ergens anders komt het niet terug als het goed is. Het mag dan ook direct gelinked worden naar de shop

acceptanceCriteria: In the Travel Tools grid, the tile label is “TravelButts shop” (matching capitalization and spacing exactly).
Clicking the “TravelButts shop” tile opens the app’s Shop page (the same route used elsewhere in the app for Shop), not “/coming-soon”.
No other labels elsewhere in the UI are changed as part of this rename.

requirements.text: Implement one-time view-count initialization for blog posts: when a blog post is opened for the first time and it has no persisted view count yet, set its initial view count to a random integer between 700 and 1000 (inclusive) and persist it; on subsequent opens, increment the persisted view count by exactly 1 per open.

quotes: Ik heb een aantal blogs online staan op de live website die niet mee worden genomen in de random viewcount van 700-1000, hoe kan ik dit het beste oplossen?

Kan het ook opgelost worden om 1 malig, alle blogs die reeds online staan de opdracht tegeven de eerste keer dat ze nu geopend worden krijgen ze een random count van 700-1000 en dat word de viewcount, daarna gewoon over op 1 keer openen is 1 view

acceptanceCriteria: If a blog post has no stored view count yet, the first call that records an open persists a random integer in the range [700, 1000] as the view count.
If a blog post already has a stored view count, each recorded open increases it by exactly 1.
The stored view count remains stable across page reloads and canister upgrades (i.e., it is persisted in canister state, not computed only on the frontend).
Existing blog posts that currently show no view count will start showing a numeric value after being opened once (because the backend initializes and persists the baseline).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not route any static assets through the backend.
nonGoals: Importing or scraping blog posts from the live website into the canister is out of scope.
Changing blog content, blog IDs/slugs, or adding new blog management UX is out of scope.
Renaming any other occurrences of “Print on Demand Travel Products” outside the specific Travel Tools tile is out of scope.
